entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane based on feudal Japan, threatened when its spirits suddenly war with its mortal inhabitants.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: The spirits that are the essence of everything on Kamigawa and that begin to wage war on mortals.

entities.name: Michiko
entities.description: The daughter of the warlord Konda, who leaves her father's fortress to find the cause of the kami's rage.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: A warlord whose fortress offers shrinking safety.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: A thief and black magic user whom Michiko meets.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: Snake-like folk Michiko consults, along with holy monks.

events.summary: The spirits of Kamigawa suddenly and inexplicably begin to wage war on the plane's mortal inhabitants.
events.quote: the spirits that are the essence of everything on it suddenly and inexplicably begin to wage war with its mortal inhabitants

events.summary: Michiko abandons her father's fortress to consult holy monks and the orochi about the kami's rage.
events.quote: abandons the shrinking safety of her father's fortress to consult holy monks and the orochi

events.summary: Michiko meets the thief Toshi Umezawa and realizes she may need unthinkable alliances.
events.quote: she realizes that to avert the destruction of Kamigawa, she may have to make some unthinkable alliances

relations.quote: Michiko , daughter of the warlord Konda

relations.note: wage war on its mortal inhabitants
relations.quote: begin to wage war with its mortal inhabitants
